gist.summary: Added @Spit-fires’ Pollinations Demo to the image app catalog and README showcase. The Hugging Face Space turns one prompt into a postcard with an image, caption, and spoken narration; visitors sign in with their own Pollen through a short-code device flow. Pollinations Blocks moved out of the README’s recent-apps list.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli wears a tiny postmaster cap and helps assemble a glowing lime green (#ecf874) postcard beside a retro screen showing its picture, caption, and sound waves, with small flowers growing around the desk; Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, small-to-medium in the scene and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites, a warm cream backdrop with mint-to-peach highlights and dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
